intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in {{cityA}}, but they are different kinds of design schools. This page compares recorded fees and placements from our database, and is honest about gaps, using official pages opened in {{year}}.

CEPT University vs National Institute of Design is a private specialist university compared with a national design institute. NID has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page, and it lists NID DAT as the admission test.

sections.heading: CEPT University vs National Institute of Design for Bachelor of Design: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose NID Ahmedabad if you want a national design institute and can take NID DAT. Our records show a 2023 average package of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹30 lakh, but we do not hold a fee row for NID on this page.
Choose CEPT University if you want a design degree at a private Ahmedabad campus. We hold a recorded year tuition of ₹2.75 lakh, plus an other charge of ₹25,000, and no placement row here.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: CEPT University has recorded tuition of ₹2.75 lakh a year and an other charge of ₹25,000. Treat the tuition as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check CEPT's current official circular.
NID has no fee row on this page. Do not guess the fee. Check NID's official admissions fee notice for the Bachelor of Design programme before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: NID's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹8 lakh and a highest package of ₹30 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
CEPT has no placement row for this programme on this page. Ask CEPT for its latest official design placement or internship report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: NID lists NID DAT on this page. Admission to NID's Bachelor of Design is through the national DAT prelims and mains process, as published each year on the official admissions site.
CEPT has no exam listed in our records here. Confirm CEPT's current undergraduate design admissions notice for tests, portfolios and eligibility.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. NID's main campus is a national institute campus in the city. CEPT is a specialist university for architecture, planning and design.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, the choice is about the institute type and the entrance test, not a change of city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you can take NID DAT and want a national design institute, NID Ahmedabad is the more documented placement side on this page, but you must get the official fee from NID itself.
If you want CEPT's design campus, use its official fee circular. Our recorded ₹2.75 lakh is a year fee, and this page has no CEPT placement row for this programme.
Do not invent a NID fee from another website. Use the official notice.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, CEPT University or NID Ahmedabad, for Bachelor of Design?
faqs.answer: NID is the national design institute, with a NID DAT route and recorded 2023 figures of a ₹8 lakh average and a ₹30 lakh highest package, but no fee row on this page. CEPT has recorded year tuition of ₹2.75 lakh and no placement row here.

faqs.question: What are the recorded design fees for CEPT vs NID?
faqs.answer: CEPT's recorded tuition is ₹2.75 lakh a year, plus an other charge of ₹25,000. NID has no fee record on this page. Check NID's official admissions fee notice.

faqs.question: Does NID accept an entrance test?
faqs.answer: Yes. NID lists NID DAT on this page. Admission follows the official DAT process published each year.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: NID's recorded 2023 average is ₹8 lakh and the highest is ₹30 lakh. CEPT has no placement record for this programme on this page.

faqs.question: Are CEPT and NID both in Ahmedabad?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses. NID is a national institute campus. CEPT is a specialist private university.
